---
title: "Tokenization Visualization"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    css: styles.css
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Enter some text and hit the "Tokenate it!" button to see token chunks and possible completions.

<div id="ntv-app" class="ntv-shell">
<div class="ntv-field">
<label for="prompt-text">Prompt</label>
<textarea id="prompt-text" rows="6" spellcheck="true">Mathematics is fairly challenging because of the </textarea>
</div>

<div class="ntv-actions">
<button id="tokenate-button" type="button">Tokenate it!</button>
<button id="clear-button" type="button" class="ntv-secondary">Clear</button>
</div>

<div style="display: none" id="status" class="ntv-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Ready.</div>

<div class="ntv-tokenized-wrap" aria-labelledby="tokenized-heading">
<div id="tokenized-heading" class="ntv-panel-heading">Tokenization</div>
<div id="tokenized" class="ntv-tokenized ntv-tokenized-empty"></div>
</div>

<div class="ntv-panel-heading">Next token candidates</div>
<div class="ntv-table-wrap">
<table id="tokens-table">
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Rank</th>
<th scope="col">Continuation</th>
<th scope="col">Probability</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td colspan="3" class="ntv-empty"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>

::: {style="display: none"}
```{ojs}
import {setupNextTokenPredictor} from './setupNextTokenPredictor.js';
setupNextTokenPredictor()
```
:::
